meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的代码库，按功能分组画出流程图，找出重复的代码或逻辑，然后提出一个更简单的统一架构方案，并生成每个系统的改造计划。
howto.when: 当你要求“找到理想路径”、统一重复的系统，或在重构前审查架构时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个项目，找出重复的功能并给出统一方案。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整流程，输出流程图和计划。

say.text: 审计当前架构，提出简化建议。
say.note: Claude 会生成重复报告和统一架构图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your codebase, creates feature-grouped flowcharts, identifies duplicated code or logic, proposes a simpler unified architecture, and generates per-system refactoring plans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Analyze this project, find duplicated concerns, and propose a unified solution.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full pipeline, outputs flowcharts and plans.

say_en.text: Audit the current architecture and suggest simplifications.
say_en.note: Claude produces a duplication report and unified architecture diagram.
